entities.name: Query ACPS
observations: The 123-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein B2GJ30 from Kocuria rhizophila.
Transfers the 4'-phosphopantetheine moiety from coenzyme A to a serine residue of apo-acyl-carrier protein.
Annotated Mg2+ cofactor/metal-binding requirement and cytoplasmic localization.
Sequence contains an ACPS Pfam domain (PF01648.26; residues 5-89).

entities.name: ACP phosphopantetheinylation
observations: apo-ACP + CoA -> holo-ACP + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:12068.
The enzyme transfers 4'-phosphopantetheine from CoA to an ACP serine side chain.
